items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Not until Faden Maribor came down here with the steamer capsule, then I realized then how famous...

ctx.x: You hadn't heard of any other pianist. You didn't know that he was much better than anything. That's right.
Not until Faden Maribor came down here with the steamer capsule, then I realized then how famous...
But your brother was so much better than anybody else that I know.
